category_title: Students who exhibit physical distress and avoidance in loud environments
minimal_context: The student is entering the gross motor room to perform sit-ups on a black mat.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We are in the gross motor room now. Let's go to the black mat in the northwest corner to do our sit-ups.

STUDENT: (Begins to cry and falls to his knees with his head on the floor as the door opens to the loud room with people coming in and out.)

TUTOR: It's time to work. Let's get ready.

STUDENT: (Continues crying while scooting across the floor, easily distracted by the million noises in the room.)

TUTOR: Come over here. (Moves the student to the mat and into a sit-up position.)

STUDENT: (Continues to cry and scoot across the floor, focusing on extraneous details that are unimportant to the development of the skill.)

options.A: Use interview prompts and a strategy inventory to measure the student's perception of self-regulated learning.
options.B: Display evidence of student goals, achievements, and numerous photographs of students around the gross motor room.
options.C: Restructure the entire class format, making the primary goal to keep the student's behaviors down.
options.D: Implement relatively tight timelines for the student to complete the sit-ups during the session.
